name: Takosu
source:
The owner of the roasted octopus restaurant "Takomaruyaki". A cheerfulness shopkeeper who calls himself a "combat cook" for some reason.

Generous and surprisingly insensitive to the other people's malice. It is said that even such a person has "something that cannot be done by any means"....

[Translated from [url=https://romankessha.wixsite.com/sadisma]official website[/url]]
